name: Generalised multiply rule
summary: Two H-boxes connected to exactly the same Z-spiders fuse, multiplying their labels.
description:
When two H-boxes with labels $a$ and $b$ are connected to exactly the same set of Z-spiders, they can be replaced by a single H-box with label $ab$. Here the Z-spiders are drawn with one output each, so that after removing them the result is a single H-box on the outputs. This is the !-box generalisation of the [multiply rule](../zh-multiply/).

A frequently used case is $a = b = -1$: two standard H-boxes on the same Z-spiders cancel, since the result has label $1$ and [disconnects](../zh-unit-generalised/). For instance, this shows that a Toffoli gate is self-inverse.
parameter_notes: Shown for H-boxes connected to n = 2 Z-spiders; holds for any n.
